scenes.title: Household checkpoint — Om, Rohan and Tara

beats.title: Om is at home
beats.plot: Shivani returns from her EP03 society pass and sees Om checking the society children's programme/event list. They exchange familiar household planning remarks, not a new introduction or attraction confession. Shivani already knows he is staying with them; exact arrangement history undisclosed.
beats.physical: Ordinary handing over of event list; no intimate contact.
beats.reaction: Shivani treats Om as a practical household elder. Reader knows his feelings are separate from her knowledge.

beats.title: Om's reader-only private moment
beats.plot: In the family's ordinary household flow Om briefly reflects on his previously established one-sided interest, entirely reader-only; he neither acts on it nor learns of any private attraction from Shivani. Do not forecast his reaction to the later mistaken-identity surprise.
beats.physical: No actual touch; no voyeurism; no Tara in private fantasy.
beats.reaction: Om remains outwardly ordinary; Shivani knows nothing.

beats.title: Rohan takes over childcare
beats.plot: PROPOSED placement: Rohan has come home from his working day by now and is with Tara. Kavya, who helped with childcare earlier, is freshening up inside. Shivani confirms the event proof at the society notice area is still waiting and goes downstairs first. Rohan agrees to stay with Tara; no unexplained empty home.
beats.physical: A brief everyday affectionate greeting between spouses, not an adult encounter.
beats.reaction: Shivani leaves reassured that Tara has childcare and her evening errand is short.

scenes.title: Deepu — The backdrop accident
scenes.location: Gulmohar Heights · community stage service alcove

beats.title: Known helper, real errand
beats.plot: Shivani meets familiar Deepu alone by the backstage panel to check tomorrow's child-program poster and standing backdrop. He already knows her standards and jokes she will count every misaligned clip. She confidently directs the layout.
beats.physical: No touch. Specific props: folding padded photo-backdrop, lightweight roll, two locking feet.
beats.reaction: Shivani leads the banter; Deepu pays attention to her decisions.

beats.title: Accidental full-body nearness
beats.plot: One of the backdrop's latches releases before the roll is secure. Deepu holds the padded panel upright while Shivani steps back from its path, catches the edge of his shirt for balance and unexpectedly ends up very close, front-to-front. He steadies her at the clothed upper back; both stop immediately when the panel is stable. It is a genuine accident, not a planned groping.
beats.physical: Brief front-to-front clothed contact, one hand on his shirt, one steadying hand at upper back; approximately 2–3 seconds.
beats.sightline: The quiet service alcove has no spectators; the doorway remains visible. No wardrobe tear, nudity, or fabricated exposure.
beats.reaction: Shivani, usually in control of teasing, loses her next sentence for an instant and feels a quick thrill. Deepu is startled and apologizes, first checking her safety.

beats.title: The different response
beats.plot: Shivani chooses a knowing, teasing reply rather than pretending she noticed nothing. Deepu answers in a more confident voice than she expected, but does not reach for her again. She completes the banner sign-off. Kavya approaches from home only after this private exchange, so she cannot report having watched the accident.
beats.physical: They separate and maintain normal work positions. No repeat of the accident.
beats.reaction: Shivani remembers that the shy-seeming society helper could hold her gaze, while Deepu resumes his work rather than assuming she wants more.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Deepu, backdrop test tha ya meri reflexes ka?

dialogue.speaker: Deepu
dialogue.line: Dono pass, ma'am. Par latch ko main dobara chance nahi dunga.

beats.title: Sister joins, new first meeting
beats.plot: Kavya comes down independently after freshening up, while Rohan remains with Tara. Shivani introduces her younger sister to Deepu, whom she herself already knows from event work. Kavya and Deepu exchange their first direct smiles. Keep her adult independence and her existing household role.
beats.physical: Ordinary introduction, no staged body contact.
beats.reaction: Deepu finds Kavya's directness refreshing. Shivani notices his unexpectedly softer voice with her.

beats.title: Two hands on the poster, two different feelings
beats.plot: Kavya asks to see the programme proof. Wind lifts one corner; Deepu and Kavya both hold it in place, their hands briefly touching along the paper edge. Kavya chooses to keep talking and asks for his name even though Shivani has said it once; Shivani notices the sincere mutual spark. This is Kavya's encounter, not an extension of Shivani/Deepu's private accident.
beats.physical: Short hand overlap at poster edge, immediately released.
beats.reaction: Kavya is interested in Deepu's thoughtful attention; Deepu responds softly. Shivani's amusement does not become jealousy.

scenes.title: Kavya's three-way spark → Shivani and the twins
scenes.location: Society cultural-event common area, beside service alcove

beats.title: Karan and Aman first see Kavya
beats.plot: Karan and Aman arrive after Ankita's ~17:50 ride and greet familiar Shivani. Morning 'Private Biology Lessons' banter is a known callback, not a first meeting. They see Kavya for the first time; she has already met Deepu privately by poster work.
beats.physical: A new introduction and first looks; no touching.
beats.reaction: Karan is direct and talkative, Aman quieter, both privately register attraction to Kavya. Kavya remains most immediately interested in Deepu.

beats.title: Three separate attractions, Kavya's choice
beats.plot: Karan openly compliments Kavya and offers to help with lightweight event boards. Aman makes a subtler remark, then offers to check her QR-proof draft. Deepu, who has already exchanged a gentle hand touch and conversation with her, offers the practical poster help she originally wanted. Kavya smiles at the attention but accepts Deepu's help first. Shivani notices the three different men reacting to her sister.
beats.physical: Kavya and Deepu pass the poster sheet hand to hand; no invented kiss or standing date.
beats.reaction: Karan finds Kavya striking and grows cheekier; Aman develops a quieter interest; Deepu and Kavya exchange a mutual, shy smile; Shivani is amused by the emerging three-way interest.

beats.title: Shivani takes over the teasing
beats.plot: With Kavya's introductions complete, Shivani draws the twins back to their morning 'Private Biology Lessons' joke. She initiates two brief, playful cheek kisses, one per twin, then laughs at their astonished reactions. As they tease her back, the adults knowingly keep the play going.
beats.physical: Two quick cheek kisses, one for Karan and one for Aman, willingly initiated by Shivani.
beats.reaction: Karan reacts openly and playfully; Aman responds with an unexpectedly confident line; Shivani feels an excited rush at her boldness.

beats.title: The closer-than-expected pose
beats.plot: The twins tease Shivani, and the three adults willingly step into a brief close, playful group pose. Karan and Aman draw her toward them; their hands briefly touch her clothed hips. She is startled by how bold the joking has become and by the possibility that someone could come around the corner; she steps away and the twins immediately release.
beats.physical: Brief shared pull and clothed hip contact. No prolonged gripping or explicit anatomy.
beats.sightline: Side of society-event area where an approaching neighbor could see them; no actual witness and no child present.
beats.reaction: A mix of delight, surprise and fleeting nervousness at being spotted. The twins become aware that the moment has become unexpectedly intense.

beats.title: Sorry, sorry — I liked it
beats.plot: Karan and Aman both apologize for having taken their joke so far. They briefly crouch in exaggerated, comic pleading at her feet, which makes Shivani laugh. She tells them to stand. With a bright smile and no further explanation, she says her exact final words, 'I liked it.' Shivani and Kavya turn and go upstairs together immediately. Scene ends on her words and exit; no speech about permission, rules or further encounter follows.
beats.physical: Twins step back and comically crouch; no further contact.
beats.reaction: The last image of this encounter is the twins taken aback by her answer as the two sisters depart. Shivani's inner doubts belong to the separate home scene, not a narrator speech at the society courtyard.

dialogue.speaker: Karan
dialogue.line: Sorry, sorry! Thoda zyada ho gaya.

dialogue.speaker: Aman
dialogue.line: Really sorry, Shivani. Hum mazaak mein beh gaye.

dialogue.speaker: Shivani
dialogue.line: Arre, utho dono. I liked it.

scenes.title: Home return, dinner, Manav and Shivani's private thoughts
scenes.location: Ahuja household · common area, dining and bedrooms

beats.title: Sisters return, Shivani processes the courtyard
beats.plot: Shivani and Kavya come upstairs after the 19:23 exchange. Rohan is home with Tara; Om is doing ordinary household tasks. Back inside, Shivani privately asks herself, 'Main wahan kya kar rahi thi?' She recalls the Deepu accident, Kavya's shy smile, and the twins' unexpected boldness without confessing the details to Rohan.
beats.physical: Family greeting, no new adult touching scene.
beats.reaction: Her confidence and self-questioning coexist: she laughed outside, but inside she is genuinely surprised by her own conduct.

beats.title: Manav's evening location established
beats.plot: Rohan helps with Tara, Kavya tells Shivani the programme proof is ready. Manav, Rohan's younger brother, returns home around 20:10 after an unspecified personal errand, greets the family and joins the household evening. No profession, companion or secret trip is invented.
beats.physical: Normal familial interaction.
beats.reaction: All resident characters have an explicit evening status; Manav is not inexplicably missing.

beats.title: Dinner and the old surprise idea
beats.plot: Dinner with Rohan, Shivani, Kavya, Tara in her family-care setting, and Manav (presence proposed). Om may attend as ordinary household resident. A private scene with Rohan reminds Shivani that her burgundy saree-and-blouse surprise from the morning was interrupted; the original private, non-nude photo is still on her phone, never shared. She decides to wear the SAME outfit again when the house is quiet.
beats.physical: A caring spouse's smile and ordinary household warmth, not an extra encounter.
beats.reaction: Her wish to surprise Rohan is genuine and distinct from the surprise she herself experienced outside.

beats.title: Everyone's position before the interruption
beats.plot: Tara becomes restless instead of going straight to sleep. Manav retires to his own room. Kavya withdraws to her room. Shivani is in their bedroom preparing the burgundy outfit, assuming Rohan will be in the lounge later. Rohan is with Om in the common area when a request for an important errand is raised.
beats.physical: No adult intimate contact.
beats.reaction: Shivani is unaware that the person waiting in the living room will change while she dresses.

scenes.title: The wrong surprise — Om in the living room
scenes.location: Ahuja household · hallway and living room, then Tara's bedroom

beats.title: Om's important errand sends Rohan out
beats.plot: Om asks Rohan to handle an important, time-sensitive household matter outside. Its precise purpose is not revealed to the readers. Rohan takes his keys and leaves; he expects to be back shortly. Tara is safely with Om in the living room for these minutes. Shivani, still in her bedroom dressing for her husband, does not hear the change of plans.
beats.physical: No adult touching.
beats.reaction: This is a practical timeline switch, not a contrivance that Rohan remains absent all night.

beats.title: Burgundy surprise outfit, no new photograph
beats.plot: Shivani changes into the same burgundy saree and fitted blouse that she had worn for the private, non-nude photo intended for Rohan that morning. She checks the drape and her reflection, unaware that Rohan has already left. She does not take or share a new photograph.
beats.physical: She is fully clothed; neckline, shoulders and silhouette are consistent with the outfit. No invented exposure, undressing or child presence in the dressing room.
beats.reaction: She anticipates only a warm, private surprise for her own husband.

beats.title: Surprise — but not Rohan
beats.plot: Shivani opens the bedroom door toward the living room with a playful 'Surprise!' meant for Rohan. Instead, she sees Om sitting with Tara. Both adults realize the mistake in an instant. Om has seen her in a dressed-up outfit that she intended to reveal privately to her husband; she freezes for a moment in surprise, visibly startled. No touch, extended inspection, private fantasy or follow-on Om reaction is narrated.
beats.physical: A brief unexpected view of a fully clothed adult in a fitted burgundy outfit; no nudity or tactile contact. This is not a sexual encounter and the young child is only in an ordinary family living room.
beats.sightline: Hallway-to-living-room doorway. The mistaken-identity surprise lasts moments, not a prolonged spectacle.
beats.reaction: Shivani's expression changes from playful confidence to astonishment. Om's private emotional reaction is explicitly reserved for a later author discussion.

beats.title: Tara's call ends the moment
beats.plot: Tara calls 'Mumma!' from the living room. Shivani responds to her daughter immediately. Om quietly excuses himself and goes to another household area; Shivani takes over childcare, comforts Tara and settles her in her own bed. Om does not return to the scene, and no further reaction or conversation with him is written.
beats.physical: Caregiving only, separate from the adults' later bedroom intimacy.
beats.reaction: Shivani regains composure. She does not tell Rohan about the mistaken surprise when he returns.

scenes.title: Rohan returns — loving, passionate night
scenes.location: Ahuja household · married couple's private bedroom

beats.title: Rohan back home; surprise finally reaches him
beats.plot: Rohan finishes Om's errand and returns home. Tara is safely settled asleep in her own room, Manav and Kavya remain in their own rooms, and Om is elsewhere in the household. Shivani is still dressed in her original burgundy surprise outfit, ready at last for Rohan to see it. She chooses not to recount the earlier accidental meeting with Om.
beats.physical: Ordinary loving greeting in private, no graphic detail.
beats.reaction: Rohan is delighted and affectionate, naturally responding to a surprise meant for him.

beats.title: The day's encounters remain in Shivani's mind
beats.plot: Privately Shivani recalls the Deepu backdrop accident, the separate spark between Kavya and Deepu, the twins' daring teasing and her own 'I liked it', and the abrupt shock of seeing Om while wearing Rohan's intended surprise. She is unsettled by how vividly these moments stay with her, yet wants her husband and acts on that desire. No private reader-only Om thoughts are placed into her consciousness.
beats.physical: Mutual affectionate closeness between husband and wife; no explicit sex acts narrated.
beats.reaction: She is more eager and proactive than on an ordinary evening, and Rohan notices her excitement. The story does not treat Om's unexpected view as an invitation or permission.

beats.title: A playful husband-wife connection — fade to black
beats.plot: Rohan compliments her burgundy look and answers her initiative with enthusiasm. He has a brief passing thought that he may see Ankita during the next morning's society walk, but this remains a possibility, not a scheduled meeting; the night remains focused on Shivani. Husband and wife willingly share an unusually passionate, deeply enjoyable intimate night. The narrative fades to black without describing sexual actions or erotic vocalization in detail.
beats.physical: Husband-wife intimacy acknowledged, but not depicted graphically.
beats.reaction: Shivani and Rohan mutually enjoy each other's affection and feel closer. A brief breathless laugh and quiet shared sigh before the fade are sufficient non-graphic tonal cues.

dialogue.speaker: Rohan
dialogue.line: Aaj toh tumne sach mein surprise kar diya.

beats.title: Loving afterglow and sleep
beats.plot: After the fade to black, both partners are content. Rohan checks that Shivani is comfortable, they exchange a few affectionate words and fall asleep close together. No explicit post-sex detail, no late visit by Om, no unexplained movement by Tara, Kavya or Manav. Episode 04A ends for Shivani.
beats.physical: Quiet affectionate closeness and sleeping; no on-page sex details.
beats.reaction: Their established good marriage feels energized and affectionate; the Om incident remains unspoken and his reaction unrevealed.

scenes.prosePreview:
Shivani ne Rohan ko dekha aur uske liye subah se sambhaal kar rakha surprise aakhir us tak pahunch gaya. Uski aankhon mein khushi dekhkar Shivani khud aage badhi. Rohan uski aaj ki bejhijhak, alag-si energy se hairaan bhi tha aur khush bhi.

Dono ek-doosre ke kareeb aaye; halka-sa hansna aur ek saath chhuti saans kamre ki khamoshi mein ghul gaye. Us raat unki pehle se pyaari married chemistry aur gehri mehsoos hui.

*Fade to black.*

Baad mein ek-doosre ka khayal rakhte hue dono pyaar aur sukoon se so gaye.

approvalRules: Shivani's last sentence at the twins encounter is exactly 'I liked it.' No permission lecture, moral explanation or additional teasing follows before she and Kavya leave. This one scene's response is not prospective consent.

All three adult men's distinct attraction to Kavya is established before Shivani's twin-teasing cliff; Kavya's first preference is for her practical interaction with Deepu, not automatic interest in everyone.
Rohan is Shivani's husband and is HOME while society twins' encounter takes place. He is not a spectator at the community event; he is with Tara. This avoids unexplained husband ignorance.
Original burgundy saree/blouse from Shivani EP02 morning private photo is used for the late night attempted surprise; do not invent a new outfit or expose her.

Om is an unrelated household elder, not Shivani's actual father-in-law. Om is allowed to see the accidental surprise, but NO Om internal reaction, fantasy, gossip, touching, or later initiative is written after that event.
Tara is a child and appears ONLY in family caregiving; no intimacy involving or witnessed by Tara. Om exits when she calls, and intimacy occurs privately only after Tara is asleep.
Manav's evening status now proposed: ~20:10 arrival from personal errands, family dinner, own room from 21:40. No unsupported occupation or side plot.
Husband-wife intimacy is willing, intense but non-graphic: acknowledge it, then fade-to-black and caring sleep. Do not write explicit acts, detailed moans or bodily anatomy.
Rohan's Jan2 curiosity to see Ankita is a future private thought only, not a new January 2 meeting, sightline or bold touching scheduled here.
EP03 and older source plans are not retrospectively rewritten; this 04A plan replaces only its own earlier proposed night details.
